execution_boundary.meaning: Role packets describe proposed work scopes, not executed identities, current assignments, deployed models, credential grants or signed opinions.

packets.responsibility: Coordinate exact-source event, reconcile all workstreams, and distinguish archive import, retrieval and admission from model learning.
packets.deliverable: A sanitized CCB event checkpoint, immutable source heads, tested changes, independent dissent and honest open gates.

packets.responsibility: Challenge whole-stack architecture and data/permission boundaries across STM, MemoryLedger, DMS and Vera Mono.
packets.deliverable: An invariant and threat map showing ownership of source custody, currentness, retrieval and consent.

packets.responsibility: Validate source-to-index schema, uniqueness, branch mapping, history clocks, conflict and correction states.
packets.deliverable: Pure schema/conformance tests with missing-row, duplicate-ID, stale-index and branch-edit controls.

packets.responsibility: Package reproducible read-only recount and bounded catalog tools without rewriting encrypted source or changing runtime routing.
packets.deliverable: Minimal CLI/runbook, dependency pins, safe failure behavior and reproducible artifact hashes.

packets.responsibility: Own source/registry custody and evidence classes; prevent public GitHub or CCB transcript leakage.
packets.deliverable: Sanitized provenance receipts binding source ZIP, encrypted vault and exact code heads without raw private identifiers.

packets.responsibility: Qualify Lappy operator workflow, storage reserve, restart and resource-appropriate verification without probing unrelated devices.
packets.deliverable: Host-only inspection/recount receipt with exact exit code, elapsed time and no content leakage.

packets.responsibility: Independently adversarially test malicious ZIP data, owner/consent forgery, retrieval leaks and privilege confusion.
packets.deliverable: Source-bound threat model, reproduced falsifiers, safe failure cases and explicit unresolved security findings.

packets.responsibility: Minimize account archive space, retention burden, backup paths and unnecessary duplicate plaintext/materialization.
packets.deliverable: Resource and recovery review with no destructive cleanup absent separate exact authority.

packets.responsibility: Independently accept or reject every bounded source/test/Lappy/Android/model inference claim on exact artifacts.
packets.deliverable: Evidence matrix with PASS, FAIL, UNKNOWN and no cross-class elevation.

packets.responsibility: Challenge role authorization, historical self-ascription, present-truth promotion and model training claims.
packets.deliverable: Governance correction list and least-authority decision record.

packets.responsibility: Lead root-cause debugging of failed source recount, transport hangs, index races and deterministic importer faults.
packets.deliverable: Pinned predecessor failure, discriminating hypotheses and a minimal correction oracle for implementation.

packets.responsibility: Independently verify Masa's regression or Hephaestus's correction without acting as their shared author.
packets.deliverable: Independent candidate diff, positive/hostile test matrix and subject-bound verdict.

packets.responsibility: Implement bounded, reviewable archive/auth/retrieval repairs from accepted defects without changing native ChatGPT Project authority.
packets.deliverable: Small PR with focused tests, install-state guard and independent Mune/Nine acceptance handoff.

open_runtime_gates: Lappy original ZIP to encrypted SQLite index independent source recount
owner-bound consent and revocation for historical recall
private durable encrypted lookup and backup/restore qualification
Android V2 principal pairing without disturbing V1
selected Vera model receives bounded provenance-labelled historical answer
separate evaluation before any neural weight learning claim
